name: v0.22.0
body:
## What's Changed

* ⚠️ Deprecated +kubebuilder:validation:Required and +kubebuilder:validation:Optional markers in favor of shorter +required and +optional forms (both continue to work) by @camilamacedo86 in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1390
* ⚠️ Generate ApplyConfig ExtractFuns when kubebuilder:resource marker is absent by @camilamacedo86 in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1449
* ✨ crd: Add k8s:listType and k8s:listMapKey markers by @itzPranshul in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1357
* ✨ webhook: Add patch field for webhook customization by @camilamacedo86 in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1339 https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1461
* 🌱 crd/markers: Emit cheaper CEL rules for `oneOf` markers by @HadrienPatte in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1408
* 🐛 Fix marker parser misinterpreting number-ish strings as numeric literals by @sivchari in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1366
* 🐛 Accept `encoding.TextMarshaler` types as CRD map keys by @HadrienPatte in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1419
* 🐛 Handle `omitzero` in `OneOf` constraint validation by @HadrienPatte in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1375
* 🐛 crd: Fix duplicate MinProperties/MaxProperties by @camilamacedo86 in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1398
* 🐛 crd: Panic when parsing type aliases from indirectly imported packages by @camilamacedo86 in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1399
* 🐛 crd: Raise error message instead of crash when using unnamed struct types by @camilamacedo86 in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1394

## Misc

* 🌱 Add OS-specific files and build artifacts to .gitignore by @camilamacedo86 in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1403
* 🌱 Add copyright header validation & fix findings by @sbueringer in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1451
* 🌱 Add envtest tests for +kubebuilder:default={} with nested field defaults by @camilamacedo86 in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1392
* 🌱 Add new test to ensure that pointer embedded structs with the inline JSON tag works by @camilamacedo86 in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1395
* 🌱 Add tests to improve coverage for IntOrStringWithEnumSlice by @dongjiang1989 in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1385
* 🌱 Add verify-generated check for golden files by @dongjiang1989 in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1457
* 🌱 Declare contents: read permissions for pr-verify action by @arpitjain099 in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1412
* 🌱 Migrate to Ginkgo v2 and ensure test temp directories are cleaned up on failure by @camilamacedo86 in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1396
* 🌱 Replace gopkg.in/yaml with sigs.k8s.io/yaml and go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 by @camilamacedo86 in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1440
* 🌱 Revert "Migrate away from custom GitHub action approval workflow" by @sbueringer in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1428
* 📖 Add comprehensive XValidation CEL documentation and examples by @camilamacedo86 in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1341
* 📖 Improve documentation about path behaviour by @camilamacedo86 in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1438
* 📖 Update README compatibility matrix and remove stale content by @HadrienPatte in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1435

## envtest

* ✨ Release envtest v1.36.2 by @yuluo-yx in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1444
* ✨ Release envtest v1.37.0 by @dongjiang1989 in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1468
* 🌱 Promotion of envtest release for Kubernetes v1.36.2 by @sbueringer in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1445
* 🌱 Promotion of envtest release for Kubernetes v1.37.0 by @sbueringer in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/controller-tools/pull/1471
